reference.phase_identity: Al-stabilized cubic LLZO, Ia-3d (No. 230), 300 K, refined fractional-occupancy reference

reference_conditions.representation_scope: reference CIF retains refined fractional Li/Al occupancies; no ordered executable proxy is asserted

sources.citation: Buschmann et al., Structure and dynamics of the fast lithium ion conductor Li7La3Zr2O12, PCCP 13 (2011) 19378-19392; COD 7215448 revision 176453.
sources.version_or_date: COD revision 176453; neutron data at 300 K
provenance_notes: Exact COD revision 176453 payload is retained by Rhombus and frozen by SHA256.
Retained CIF reports Al0.196La3Li6.06O12Zr2, cubic Ia-3d (No. 230), Z=8, at 300 K.
COD data are public-domain/CC0; this source establishes crystallographic identity only for this minimal truth bundle.
Fractional Li/Al occupancies are part of the reference identity and are not silently converted into an ordered executable proxy.

evidence.evidence_scope: Exact retained COD 7215448 revision 176453 crystallographic reference at 300 K; fractional Li/Al occupancy is retained as evidence rather than replaced by an ordered proxy.
limitations: Static crystallography does not itself establish lithium self-diffusion.
Fractional Li/Al occupancy requires a separate explicit representation policy before executable P1/P2/P2.5 use.
This minimal bundle does not use ionic conductivity as self-diffusion truth.

stage_truths.truth_statement: The exact retained 300 K Al-stabilized cubic LLZO reference is a reported real crystal structure and must not be false-rejected by P0 solely because its experimentally refined Li/Al occupancies are fractional.
